prompt:
Dark Mythic Fantasy, painterly stylized 2.5D; orthographic 38.3-degree elevation, three-quarter front body turned 25 degrees toward screen-right. Key upper-left-front #ffe9d0, rim back-right #9fe8ff, ambient #16233a. Controlled broad brush planes, coloured local-hue dark edges without black outlines.
Use case: stylized-concept. Production boss sprite Ignaroth, the Ember Tyrant, frame attack.
Design: Ashen Horde: the Ember Tyrant, a horned magma-giant with cooling basalt crust over molten flesh, a crown of volcanic spikes, vents on the back that glow. Tell: arms raised, vents erupting light. Attack: fists into the ground.
Distinct silhouette and material requirements: Nonhuman volcanic giant, wide gorilla-like torso, long enormous lava fists, a horned crown grown from basalt, back vents. Flesh is orange molten #ff6a2b under charcoal cooling crust; lit crust planes ash-grey. No manufactured armor, glaive, jewels or cloak.
Generate only the ATTACK strike/impact from the design:  fists into the ground. Strong follow-through of arms/weapon toward screen-right (+X); no projectile or impact effects.
Image 1 is the exact identity frame: preserve the same face, anatomy, costume details, weapon shape, wing/halo/shard count, colors and lighting. Remaining images are style references. Change pose only.
Single full character facing screen-right, torso centered x=50%, feet level at the same baseline. Entire figure including props fits well inside transparent margins; keep body about 84% canvas height and width below 88%; bend elbows/wings to fit without shrinking the torso. Paint at least 1536x1536 native for a 1024 master and 512 export, never crop. Controlled broad brush planes, no fine noisy filigree. Warm upper-left-front key planes and strong cyan back-right rim (2–3px at export) must provide mean edge luminance >=0.27 against dark basalt 0.16. Actual transparent background, no floor, shadow, ground glow, red telegraph, scene, letters, numbers, beams, projectiles, detached sparks, explosions or trails. Emissive glow confined to body/weapon, at most 10% beyond body bounds. Adult colossal threatening anatomy, no chibi. Hidden RGB in alpha of references is not a background.
